value.rationale: Directional edge weights arise naturally when a two-by-two isotone table represents anisotropic axes. The diamond is the minimal cyclic-cover poset, and the prior broader rigidity result leaves the quantitative stability law undetermined. An exact attained coefficient with parameter symmetry and arbitrarily large anisotropic gain is a structural quantitative benchmark with an explicit extremal mechanism, not a routine restatement of the qualitative contraction threshold.
